title: Spin the wheel faster
hook: Change angular speed and predict rotational kinetic energy.
misconception: rotational kinetic energy doubles when angular speed doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply K_rot = ½Iω² to compare rotational kinetic energy when angular speed changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a rigid object with fixed moment of inertia, K_rot = ½Iω². When angular speed doubles, rotational kinetic energy becomes 4 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model K_rot = ½Iω²; scaling exponent 2. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a rigid object with fixed moment of inertia, with a nonzero initial result. If angular speed triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on rotational kinetic energy?
recall.why: Apply K_rot = ½Iω² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 9.
